user.title: Home Control
user.description: Adds the Home Control dashboard to the sidebar. Nothing else on your Home Assistant is changed: your own dashboards and your default dashboard stay as they are. To open Home Control first, choose it under Profile, Default dashboard (a setting of each browser).

abort.already_configured: Home Control is already set up.

init.description: How the dashboard appears in the sidebar. Changing the address changes the web address of the dashboard.
